verdict.rationale: Sift is fundamentally an API-first fraud service (Events/Decisions/Score APIs) with curl-based docs, and the runtime probe confirms the Events API responds to plain HTTP calls without any UI, which supports headless/automated use in CI or scripts. However, there is no explicit CI-specific tooling, CLI, or pipeline integration guide, and no SDKs beyond iOS/Android are mentioned for server-side automation frameworks. missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD integration docs or CLI, broader server-side SDK coverage, evidence of automated test/CI usage patterns.
